findings.description: The Security template in `4-security.yml` asks for a threat ID and attack description, and `config.yml` disables blank issues without adding a contact link to a private reporting channel. Anyone who picks this form in a public repository will file the vulnerability description as a public issue, which exposes it before a fix exists.
findings.title: Public security form invites public vulnerability reports

findings.description: Each form's `labels: ["type: …"]` attribute assumes the matching label already exists in the repository, and nothing in this PR creates them (no label definition file or sync workflow is added). If a label is missing, the issue created from that form is not tagged, so triage by `type:` label silently misses it.
findings.title: Type labels may not exist, so forms file untyped issues
